comparison.objective: Discharge a capacitor, then extract and box a circuit board.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a two-pin discharge tool on two pads for two seconds, then pull and place a board.
comparison.success_condition: Discharge must precede extraction; board ends in the box. No detailed contact/charge thresholds are given.
comparison.reason: This tests sustained two-point electrical contact and board extraction, not captive-screw tooling, collar adjustment, or tuning from repeated impacts.
